# harborpilot_quota_monitor (Resource)

Polls a provider's quota or balance. Prefer the `*_ref` spec fields over write-only secrets.

Changes made outside Terraform are detected on refresh and shown as a diff of `spec`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harborpilot_quota_monitor" "deepseek" {
  name = "deepseek-balance"
  spec = jsonencode({
    adapter            = "deepseek"
    account_id         = harborpilot_provider_account.deepseek.id
    api_key_ref        = "env:HP_SECRET_DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"
    poll_interval_secs = 600
    enabled            = true
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name (lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-`).
- `spec` (String) The quota monitor specification as JSON, usually written with `jsonencode({...})`. See the `QuotaMonitorSpec` schema in the Harbor Pilot API reference. Properties you leave out take the server's default, usually their zero value (empty string, list or map, `0`, `false`), except `enabled`, which must be set.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `secrets_wo` (Map of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only secret values by name (`api_key`, `management_key`, `access_token`, `service_account`). Never stored in state or plan. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. Sent on create and whenever `secrets_wo_version` changes. Prefer secret references in the spec.
- `secrets_wo_version` (Number) Change this number to send `secrets_wo` again (for example after rotating a secret).

### Read-Only

- `drift_state` (String) `drifted` when the object was changed outside Terraform since Terraform last wrote it.
- `id` (String) Stable object id.
- `managed_by` (String) Source of the last change (`terraform` after an apply).
- `revision` (Number) Server revision, used for optimistic concurrency.
- `secret_names` (Set of String) Names of the secrets currently set on the server (stored or referenced). Values are never returned.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id or by name.
terraform import harborpilot_quota_monitor.example <id-or-name>
```
